blocks.text: A trigger is anything that makes you want to go to the golf club when you are supposed to be at home. The Programme has identified the most common ones.

text: • A clear forecast for the weekend.
• A text from Keith that says "You out Saturday?"
• The clocks going forward in spring.
• Golf on the telly, especially the big tournaments, and anything with Americans shouting.
• A new driver that "everyone at the club" has.
• The words "I'm taking the kids to my mum's this weekend, so you're free to do what you like."
